Citizen 0.7.6 resolves the earlier display-name rejection and cleans up source and CSS review warnings.

- Keep the citizen plugin ID, saved settings, room protocol 14, and checkpoint format 14.
- Use typed network/statistics boundaries, Obsidian DOM helpers, explicit HTTP adapters, and current spatial-audio parameters.
- Replace flagged CSS rules while preserving Hangar, HUD, and room controls.
- Keep note metadata local and copy room codes only on user action.

Install the three attached files (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css) into <vault>/.obsidian/plugins/citizen/. ZIP/checksums are available as workflow artifacts. Requires desktop Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer. See docs/verification-0.7.6.md for checks and runtime limits.
